company_name: Taichi Metal Material Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides specialized equipment and materials that can be used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Taichi Metal Material Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the design and application of liquid alloys, offering process equipment and technology development services. Their products include manual bead-jetting machines, laser measurement tools, and thermal radiation insulation films, which are applicable in semiconductor manufacturing for metal surface treatment and corrosion resistance.
capabilities: Laser conjugate focal surface measurement tools
Thermal radiation insulation films (TCM 6090 and TCM 7090)
Customized equipment and testing services for metal surface treatment
